q: Let $x_1,x_2,\ldots,x_n$ be positive real numbers satisfying $x_1 = 1+\frac{1}{x_2}$, $x_2 = 1+\frac{1}{x_3}$, $\ldots$, $x_n = 1+\frac{1}{x_1}$. (i) Show that $x_i > 1$ for each $i$. (ii) Show that $x_1 - x_2 = \frac{x_3 - x_2}{x_2x_3}$. (iii) Hence show that $x_1 = x_2 = \cdots = x_n$ and find the value of $x_1$.
answer: (i) Since $x_2>0$, $1/x_2>0$, so $x_1 = 1+1/x_2 > 1$; the same holds for every $x_i$. (ii) Subtract the equations for $x_1$ and $x_2$: $x_1-x_2 = \frac{1}{x_2}-\frac{1}{x_3} = \frac{x_3-x_2}{x_2x_3}$. Repeating the cyclic step gives $(x_1-x_2)\left(1\mp\frac{1}{x_2^2x_3^2\cdots x_n^2 x_1^2}\right)=0$ (sign depending on $n$). (i) gives $x_1^2x_2^2\cdots x_n^2\neq\pm1$, so $x_1=x_2$, and by symmetry all $x_i$ are equal. (iii) With $x_i=x$, $x = 1+1/x$, so $x^2-x-1=0$, giving $x=\frac{1\pm\sqrt{5}}{2}$. The negative root is rejected since $x_i>0$, so $x=\frac{1+\sqrt{5}}{2}$.

q: Find all the solutions of the equation $|x+1| - |x| + 3|x-1| - 2|x-2| = x+2$.
answer: $x=-2$ or $x\geq 2$. Case analysis over the regions $x\leq -1$, $-1\leq x\leq 0$, $0\leq x\leq 1$, $1\leq x\leq 2$, $x\geq 2$ gives the solutions $x=-2$ and every $x\geq 2$.

q: Find the coefficient of $x^6$ in $(1-2x+3x^2-4x^3+5x^4)^3$. (ii) By considering the binomial expansions of $(1+x)^{-2}$ and $(1+x)^{-6}$, or otherwise, find the coefficient of $x^6$ in $(1-2x+3x^2-4x^3+5x^4-6x^5+7x^6)^3$.
answer: (i) 369. (ii) 462, since the cube of the series for $(1+x)^{-2}$ is the series for $(1+x)^{-6}$, whose $x^6$ coefficient is $\frac{11!}{6!\,5!}=462$.
